The Trading report retains every violation and incomplete check. Passing non-regression never means contrast-clean or WCAG compliance.
The React example's added height={400} line is disclosed; no compared content was rewritten.
Copied feedback uses genuine Chromium clipboard success only.
Transition samples match existing native keyframes, easing, focus, hover and animation time. No color declaration was changed.
Unsynchronized natural post-click observations are not classified as matched transition phases.
Incomplete checks and untested states remain review items.
Original Trading colors and all five original visual PNG images remain unchanged.
This evidence is not human screen-reader validation, WCAG conformance, merge permission or release permission.
